source: https://data.binance.vision (Binance USD-M futures monthly archives, daily archives for whole missing days)

format.1m: np.savez_compressed layout (fixed zip timestamps); keys ts(int64 ms open time UTC),o,h,l,c,v(base vol),qv(quote vol),mo,mh,ml,mc (mark price OHLC, NaN where no mark bar); all float64 except ts; file <1m>/<SYM>.npz
format.funding: keys ts(int64 ms calc_time UTC), rate(float64 last_funding_rate); file funding/<SYM>.npz
format.arrays_sha256: sha256 over the sorted keys: name|dtype|shape newline, then the raw bytes

notes: rows are raw exchange bars: nothing forward-filled or synthesized, zero-volume bars kept
ts converted to ms if source used microseconds
every monthly and daily zip was checked against its .CHECKSUM (sha256) when the listing has one; see checksum_status_counts, daily_fill.daily_status and source_zips
whole days missing from the monthly archives were filled from the daily archives (daily_fill), inserting only absent bars / NaN mark values
after a coin stops trading the archive can keep producing flat zero-volume bars and fixed funding rows: use last_nonzero_volume_bar as the end of the tradable period
